English: A physiotherapist can tell you where a problem is likely coming from and how to ease it, but that takes an appointment, time and money. Home wellness devices like massage guns and heat pads are always to hand, but they leave every decision to you: where to apply it, which setting to use, for how long, and when to stop.
Chinese (your translation): 物理治疗师带给你专业的问题诊断和恢复，但需要预约，需要时间，价格也较贵。筋膜枪、热敷垫这类家用健康设备触手可及，却把每一个决定都留给你：敷在哪里、用哪一档、用多久、什么时候停。

English: Lofer brings together the best of both. It listens to how you describe your symptoms, asks a few follow-up questions, and suggests which area of your body needs the most care and which session to run. Then it delivers the session itself, with built-in safety controls, and asks how it went. When something sounds like it needs a professional, it says so.
Chinese (your translation): Lofer 把两者的长处融为一体。它倾听你对症状的描述，追问几个问题，判断身体哪个部位最需要护理、该进行哪一套方案。随后由它来完成这次护理，内置安全控制，并在结束后询问感受。若有些情况需要专业帮助，它会如实提醒。
